# Khan Explainer

Make Khan Academy style explainer videos locally on macOS: a pen draws on a blackboard or whiteboard while a voice explains, from one scene file to one MP4 — blackboard lessons, arrows and captions drawn over product screenshots, and vertical clips cut from a YouTube video or podcast with the speaker's real audio, using HTML canvas, Playwright, the built-in `say` voice and ffmpeg, with optional ElevenLabs or free local Kokoro voices.
